pairing_rule: First fifteen employer sources paired with profiles in original odd ordinal positions; last fifteen with even ordinal positions. No outcome-based pairing or tuning.
reference_method: Codex authored concise requirements from official employer pages and three evidence-gap judgments per pair before this phase predictions. Same assistant family also helped author taxonomy and profiles. Different tested model: Gemini. AI agreement is not correctness.
chronology: Added after earlier fictional-JD 10+20 experiments. All thirty profiles were seen in those earlier experiments; these are new real-JD/profile pairs, not thirty unseen profiles or an original preregistered holdout.
student_review_scope: Confirmed personal review covers original RLV2F-01..10 only, after their prediction run. No personal review is asserted for RLR30-01..30.
limitations: Curated, English, senior-heavy sample; eight employer brands, not representative of the entire PM job market.
Requirement summaries can omit or emphasize content; exact-quote validation is against these summaries, not the full employer advertisements.
Taxonomy does not separately assess scientific or security domain expertise, work authorization, degrees, tenure or other eligibility constraints.
Synthetic profiles, shared author framing and prior profile exposure limit generalization. No recruiter or interview-success validation.

metrics.case_agreement: at least two of three reference IDs matched / 30, abstentions zero

reporting: Primary final real-requirement experiment. Do not pool with historical fictional-JD runs.
